Definitions (implemented in cmat 636, orthoRows 641, concatInfo 642, contrastStats 649, variant/hpCost 661–663, analyse 610):
- t contrast: SE/σ = sqrt(c'(X'X)^- c) per run.
- F contrast: orthonormalize the rows of C in column-weight space (Gram–Schmidt) before computing V = C(X'X)^- C'; report sqrt(λmax(V)) (worst direction) and the row count. Without orthonormalization the number depends on how rows are written (rescaling, duplicating, mixing); this was a real defect in an earlier round (RMS of row variances was also wrong).
- Estimability: compute the null space of X'X (eigendecomposition of the column-scaled X'X, relative tolerance 1e-9); c is estimable iff |c·v| < 1e-6·‖c‖ for every null vector v. Report reasons: a weighted column has no events in this run (dropped), or the contrast separates aliased columns.
- Sparse aliased sets: reduce the null-space basis to row-echelon form (pivoted Gauss–Jordan, zero entries below 1e-6), then present each vector as an equation "A = B" or "A = B + C" with coefficients (largest coefficient on the left). Sort smallest set first. The raw eigenvectors are arbitrary rotations and mix unrelated sets.
- Fixed-effects combination over runs (common σ assumed and stated): C_comb = (Σ_r V_r^-1)^-1 over runs where the contrast is estimable; report how many runs contributed.
- Concatenated runs (shared task coefficients, per-run nuisance/drift): information I = Σ_r inv(B_r), where B_r is the task-column block of the run's (X'X)^-; V = C I^-1 C'. Verified against an explicit block design with shared task columns.
- High-pass cost: build the design with the cosine set at the chosen cutoff and with no cosines; cost = λmax(V_with)/λmax(V_without) − 1 (white-noise assumption, stated). Also provide the table over cutoffs (64, 96, 128, 192, 256, 384 s). An earlier "fraction of contrast regressor removed by projection" metric misranked contrasts (e.g. DMS delay load 15% removed but +3% variance; gamble accept − reject 8.6% removed but +28% variance) — do not use it as the cost.
- Nuisance df: per-run count of motion, confound and censoring columns and the residual df N − rank.
Verified numbers (critiques/m2b-, m3-, m4b-methods.md; audit dirs with recompute.py, checks.py, fcheck.py):
- Fixed effects t: DMS probe − sample runs 0.2272 / 0.2267 → combined 0.1605; errors − correct estimable only in run 1 → 0.4990.
- F √λmax: block 0.0536, stop 0.2449, dense 0.7022; invariant to rescaling, duplication, mixing, reordering of rows.
- DMS + duplicate Probe term: rank 27, df 183, nullity 4 (four singular values ≈ 2e-15); 3/6 contrasts estimable with SE/σ unchanged from the full-rank model (0.1421, 0.2367, 0.0678); alias sets lie in the SVD null space (‖Xv‖/(‖X‖‖v‖) ≤ 8e-13) and span it.
- High-pass cost: gamble accept − reject +28%; stop "any failed-stop response" F +51% at 128 s.
Also required by the studio (invariant I4, identifiability): a cheap check that refuses a design whose task + nuisance columns reach the scan count, evaluated on every change (an LSS→LSA switch on the stop FIR design once tried to build 1270 columns for 200 scans and hung).
Acceptance: fixtures reproduce the numbers above; row-invariance property tests; rank-deficient fixture with sparse sets equal to the four ±1 pairs of the duplicate-term case.
